description: Bend arm at high transport height before staging; use live bent TCP offset for pre-grasp. Full remote 50/10 improved 37→40.

asi.hypothesis: A moderate elbow bend (shoulder -0.60, elbow +1.20, wrist -0.60) shortens TCP offset, raises elbow clear of fixtures, and gives IK a less stretched pre-grasp.
asi.result: Improved 40/50; local former failures 10/13 succeeded. Remaining failures need arm/grasp or final placement analysis.
